title: Chemical bonding - 123 school
heading: Chemical bonding
intro: You learn these terms and calculations by practising. Only use BINAS when the question names a BINAS table.

questions.question: What is a covalent bond?

answers.a: A bond between metal atoms and free electrons
answers.b: A bond in which two atoms share electrons
answers.c: A bond between a positive and a negative ion

questions.question: What is a shared electron pair?

answers.a: Two electrons that are shared by two atoms
answers.b: Two electrons that an atom gives up

answers.a: A bond in which the electrons are shared equally
answers.d: A bond in which the electrons are not shared equally between the atoms

questions.question: Which bond is polar? (electronegativity: H = 2.1; Cl = 3.0)
In an H–Cl bond, Cl is more electronegative (3.0) than H (2.1). Which atom gets the partial negative charge?
Why is CO<sub>2</sub> a non-polar molecule, although the C=O bonds are polar?

answers.d: The molecule is linear and symmetrical, so the charges cancel out

questions.question: Why is an H<sub>2</sub>O molecule polar?

answers.a: The molecule is bent, so the charges do not cancel out

questions.question: What is the van der Waals force?

answers.c: A strong bond within a molecule
answers.d: A weak attraction between all molecules

questions.question: What happens to the van der Waals force when the molecular mass becomes greater?

answers.a: The van der Waals force stays the same
answers.b: The van der Waals force becomes weaker
answers.c: The van der Waals force disappears
answers.d: The van der Waals force becomes stronger

questions.question: Which substance has the highest boiling point? (use BINAS table 42B)

answers.c: They boil at the same temperature

questions.question: What condition must a molecule meet to be able to form hydrogen bonds?

answers.b: It contains only carbon and hydrogen
answers.d: It contains an H atom bonded to O or N

questions.question: Between the molecules of which substance are there hydrogen bonds?
Why is the boiling point of water higher than that of H<sub>2</sub>S?

answers.d: Water has a greater van der Waals force than H<sub>2</sub>S

answers.c: The covalent bonds within the molecules
